title: Self-serve Tuning Advisory Onboarding + Priority Matrix for Enterprise Customers
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a lightweight, self-serve onboarding flow and priority matrix for customer tuning requests (batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policies). Goal: reduce manual triage time, surface appropriate SLA-aware routing (Advisory, Solutions, Engineering), and produce an actionable packet for advisory engagements. The intake should capture runtime profile, cost/latency targets, privacy constraints, and a minimum reproducibility test case.
acceptance_criteria: A public intake form (hosted page + Zendesk/Support link) that captures required fields: workload description, model family, token volumes, current cost metrics, target SLOs, sensitive data flags, and representative prompt sample.
A scorecard that assigns a priority bucket automatically and suggests routing: Self-serve docs, Advisory consult, Dedicated Eng work, or Strategic initiative.
Automated labels in Linear + Support queue created from intake (e.g., label: advisory-high-cost, advisory-latency-critical).

Runbook describing handoff steps for Advisory engagements including expected artifacts (eval notebooks, perf traces, KV cache dumps), estimated time-to-first-response, and escalation path for enterprise SLA customers.
Dashboards or saved search in Console/Sheets to track intake volume, conversion rate to paid engagements, and mean time to triage.
comments: 2025-02-04 | Ava Chen: Created initial ticket and draft intake fields. Draft anchored to three verticals: latency, cost, and model quality regressions. Suggested minimal viable intake to reduce friction.

2025-02-16 | Support lead (Liam O'Neil): Agreed to host the intake via Support portal and add tags; asked for a JSON webhook payload for automation into Linear. Action: Eng to provide mapping by 2025-02-20.

2025-02-20 | Jordan Patel: Engineering intake webhook spec attached in PR. Next steps: implement automated labeling, wire up support form, and run a two-week pilot in Cycle 2025-W08.
